season: Commemoration (ranks with solemnities for this purpose)
keyVerseDR: "...every one who seeth the Son and believeth in him may have life everlasting. And I will raise him up in the last day." (Jn 6:40)

level1.title: We Pray for Those Who Died
level1.story: Jesus said, "I will not turn away anyone who comes to Me." He promised to raise us up on the last day. We pray for people who have died.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: Who can you pray for today?
level1.prayer: Eternal rest grant unto them, O Lord. Amen.

activity.title: Candles for loved ones
activity.intro: Color a candle for each person who has died. Pray for them.

level2.title: I Will Raise Them Up
level2.story: Jesus said, "Him that cometh to Me, I will not cast out." He came down from heaven to do the Father's will. The Father wants Jesus to lose no one He has been given. All who believe in the Son may have life everlasting. Jesus promised, "I will raise him up in the last day."
level2.keyLine: I will raise him up in the last day.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why do Catholics pray for the dead?
How does Jesus' promise give us hope?
actions: Write names in a Book of the Dead
Pray the Eternal Rest prayer daily
level2.prayer: Lord, grant eternal rest to all the faithful departed. Amen.

activity.title: Jesus' promise
activity.intro: Read it, fold one line at a time, and say it from memory.
activity.question: What did Jesus promise those who believe?
activity.answer: I will raise him up in the last day.

art.mainBrief: Family lighting a candle at a peaceful cemetery with a cross, autumn leaves
art.heartBrief: Candles around heart; space to write names
